# Validating scenarios (Elixir)

The Elixir SDK has no separate dry-run helper. Validate scenarios by driving `Autonoma.Handler.handle/2` through the same `up` and `down` lifecycle the platform uses. This exercises real scenario code, token signing, and teardown without starting an HTTP server.

## A complete ExUnit lifecycle

Use your application's normal data-case setup so the scenario calls a real test database.

```elixir
defmodule MyApp.AutonomaScenarioTest do
  use MyApp.DataCase, async: false

  alias Autonoma.{Handler, HMAC, Scenario, Unique}

  @shared "check-shared-secret"
  @signing "check-signing-secret"

  defp scenario do
    Scenario.define_scenario(
      name: "single-user",
      description: "One verified user",
      up: fn ctx ->
        email = Unique.unique_email(ctx.test_run_id)
        user = MyApp.Accounts.create_verified_user!(email)

        %{
          teardown: %{"userId" => user.id}
        }
      end,
      down: fn ctx -> MyApp.Accounts.delete_user!(ctx.teardown["userId"]) end
    )
  end

  defp post(config, payload) do
    body = Jason.encode!(payload)
    signature = HMAC.sign_body(body, @shared)
    Handler.handle(config, %{body: body, headers: %{"x-signature" => signature}})
  end

  test "scenario provisions and tears down" do
    config = %{shared_secret: @shared, signing_secret: @signing, scenarios: [scenario()]}

    up =
      post(config, %{
        "action" => "up",
        "scenario" => %{"name" => "single-user"},
        "testRunId" => "check-run-1"
      })

    assert up.status == 200
    assert is_binary(up.body["teardownToken"])
    down =
      post(config, %{
        "action" => "down",
        "teardownToken" => up.body["teardownToken"],
        "testRunId" => "check-run-1"
      })

    assert down.status == 200
    assert down.body["ok"] == true
  end
end
```

## What to assert

- `discover` lists every scenario name and description.
- `up` returns a non-empty `teardownToken`.
- `down` succeeds with the token unchanged.
- Two distinct run IDs do not collide.
- Teardown removes every created row.

## Failure guide

| Signal | Cause | Fix |
|--------|-------|-----|
| `UNKNOWN_ENVIRONMENT` | The scenario name is not registered | Add it to `:scenarios`. |
| `INVALID_TEARDOWN_TOKEN` | The token is missing, damaged, or checked with another signing secret | Reuse the same config and pass `teardownToken` unchanged. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` during up | Customer provisioning code raised | Fix the application context call or test database state. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` during down | Cleanup state is missing or deletes in the wrong order | Return every cleanup handle from `up` and delete children first. |

Read the handler response's `code` and `error`, fix the scenario code, and rerun until both phases pass.
